origin.description: Plot one Andrews curve per row.
origin.details: The curve matrix for a 2 by 2 matrix and five angles. R time is that matrix, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Plot one Andrews curve per row.
origin.example: { A <- matrix(c(1,2,3,4), 2, 2); npts <- 5; xpts <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out=npts); Y <- matrix(NA, 2, npts); for (i in 1:2) { xs <- A[i,]; ypts <- c(); for (p in xpts) { y <- xs[1]; for (j in 2:2) { if (j %% 2 == 1) y <- y + xs[j]*sin((j %/% 2)*p) else y <- y + xs[j]*cos((j %/% 2)*p) }; ypts <- c(ypts, y) }; Y[i,] <- ypts }; pdf(file.path(tempdir(),"p.pdf")); andrewsplot(A, c(1L,2L), style="cart", npts=5); dev.off(); as.numeric(Y) }
